entities.summary: Mbundu, a notable figure in the history of Angola, associated with Kingdom of Ndongo and Queen Njinga (1500–1617). Preceded by Kingdom of Ndongo. Their legacy influenced Luanda Founded 1575 and Portuguese Foundation of Luanda.
